caption:
Figure 4. Overview of our PassionSR. Step 1: we simplify OSEDiff [42] by removing DAPE and CLIP Encoder, obtaining PassionSR-
FP. Step 2: the quantizer we use has two key trainable parts, consisting of the Learnable Boundary Quantizer and Learnable Equivalent
Transformation. Step 3: we design a distributed calibration strategy and special loss function to accelerate convergence of calibration.
delegated_acceptance_review: Viewed complete final plus enlarged calibration schedule/losses. Original PassionSR three steps, quantizer boundary equation/numeric matrices, LR/HR rose, teacher/quantized routes remain. Added LET/LBQ train/frozen schedule exactly follows original color legend, formulas reproduced from source rather than reset. Two detailed regions explicitly marked enlargements.
